title: Computing the pullback of a sheaf along a morphism from a colimit of sites

difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the pullback of a sheaf along the morphism of sites from a colimit of sites: for an object at a finite level the value of the pullback is the filtered colimit, over the stages mapping to that level, of the pullbacks of the sheaf along the transition morphisms (statement lines 4075-4087). The proof is a complete argument: continuity is taken from the companion construction and exactness is reduced to left exactness because the pullback is a left adjoint (proof lines 4089-4098); the author builds a presheaf with the displayed values, checks functoriality and the sheaf condition by reducing coverings to a finite level and commuting filtered colimits with finite limits (proof lines 4101-4130); identifies it with the pullback through the universal property of the adjunction (proof lines 4135-4168); and deduces left exactness from the formula (proof lines 4171-4179). The non-formal content is the construction of the sheaf and its universal property. The claim is H2: a construction with the verification carried out in stages.
